Layout polar radialaxis title objects

Source: R/zz-gen-layout.R
go_polar_radialaxis_title.Rd

The object for the layout's polar.radialaxis.title (go_polar_radialaxis()). go_polar_radialaxis_title() creates one, with exactly its properties; a named list with the same properties works too.

Usage

go_polar_radialaxis_title(..., font = NULL, text = NULL, skip_invalid = FALSE)

Arguments

...

Not for properties, which must be named in full: an abbreviated or unknown name is an error that suggests the right one.

font

Sets this axis' title font. A go_font() object or named list, with properties color, family, lineposition, shadow, size, style, textcase, variant and weight (see go_font()).

text

Sets the title of this axis. String.

skip_invalid

If TRUE, silently drop invalid properties instead of raising an error.

Value

A go_layout_polar_radialaxis_title object (a named list).

Details

Nested objects are named lists, or objects of the constructors their arguments name. Every property is checked against the plotly.js schema when the object is created or modified. A property may be a one-sided formula (color = ~col): it is kept, and evaluated in the data (then checked) when its trace is added to a figure with add_<trace>() or add_trace().

Examples

mtcars |>
  go_figure() |>
  add_scatterpolar(r = ~mpg, theta = ~hp) |>
  update_layout(
    polar = go_polar(
      radialaxis = go_polar_radialaxis(
        title = go_polar_radialaxis_title(text = "title")
      )
    )
  )
